text:
anya: Planning a base-image rebuild + runtime syscall tighten tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need a short-lived decrypt for the staging signer and an audit-forward + minimal forensics snapshot. Also quick RBAC check: avoid granting project-wide decrypter.

oscar: Agreed. Proposal: create svc acct `sa:image-unseal-canary@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, bind `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` only to `cryptoKeys/stage-signer`, and schedule automatic destroy after 40m. No other keys.

luis: For audit, forward cosign verify JSON to `forensics:image-audit` and also write a redacted record to `siem:image-events` (hash actor, strip email). Keep original JSON in sealed forensics bucket `gs://image-forensics/evidence.jsonl` with object ACLs for sec-only.

anya: Good. Incident response ask: if CVE shows up during canary we need an automated rollback and evidence capture. Can deploy-bot wire a lambda to capture running container metadata + kernel logs on rollback?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-05-10T02:00:00Z  30m window, 2% traffic to canary slice. Will attach rollback hook to take snapshot and call `forensics-bot`.

forensics-bot: Acknowledged. On rollback we'll capture: container image digest, host kernel dmesg, cosign raw output, scanned vuln report, and store a signed manifest in `gs://image-forensics/evidence.jsonl`. Tag events with `run:3921234000`.

oscar: RBAC snippet I'll add to infra repo as ephemeral terraform binding so we have VCS trail. Terraform resource will be destroyed by a scheduler after 40m; job will also run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and post to `forensics:image-audit` for verification. PR must include PD ack + sec approver.

luis: Vulnerability triage: grype on base-2026-05-09 shows HIGH=0 MEDIUM=1(libssl backport), LOW=3. Rebuilt with backport. Will re-run scanner in CI just before canary.

anya: One more: include attestation header in the image manifest `redwood.attest.run_id` and log it with cosign outputs for easy correlation.

oscar: Will add `redwood.attest.run_id=3921234000` to the build step and cosign will include that in notes.

luis: If anything looks off during the window, PD ack triggers immediate rollback and `forensics-bot` snapshot. Make sure the team can access sealed artifact for postmortem.

anya: thanks all. I'll post the runbook link once PR is up and coord with oncall. :white_check_mark:
